Capability positioning (authoritative):
Default: Agent memory cards=disabled, Application shell and Settings=disabled, Approvals and action permissions=disabled, Coding recovery and verification=disabled, Coding tools and file execution=enabled, Context reading and search=disabled, Knowledge retrieval=disabled, Knowledge review=disabled, Skills and MCP connections=disabled, Task ledger=disabled, Tool context=disabled, Tool discovery=disabled, Workspace context=disabled.
Advanced: Billing and usage=disabled, Browser sessions=disabled, ClawGraph=disabled, Code review=disabled, Developer settings=disabled, Image generation=disabled, Inbox=disabled, Observability=disabled, Remote tasks=disabled, Scheduled tasks and auto-approval=disabled, Worktree isolation=disabled.
Memory: scope=workspace; read=allowed; write=denied; candidate=available.
Knowledge: state=stale; version=knowledge-tf0512.
Action permissions: Agent memory cards: propose=requires-approval, read=requires-approval; Browser sessions: click=requires-approval, navigate=requires-approval, screenshot=requires-approval, type=requires-approval; Coding tools and file execution: apply_patch=requires-approval, edit=requires-approval, exec=allowed, write=requires-approval.
Availability and action permission are separate: enabled does not mean allowed.
Internal and retired capabilities are not user-facing promises. Do not claim a capability beyond these listed facts.
